newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-GLASGOW RANGERS V AJAX TEAMS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-GLASGOW RANGERS V AJAX TEAMS.

text.p: Teams for Wednesday's European Cup Champions' League Group A match between Glasgow Rangers of Scotland and Ajax Amsterdam of the Netherlands.

Glasgow Rangers: 13-Theo Snelders; 29-Scott Wilson, 5-Gordan Petric, 6-Joachim Bjorklund, 28-Greg Shields, 20-Derek McInnes, 14-Ian Durrant, 3-Joerg Albertz, 16-Charlie Miller, 15-David Robertson, 11-Brian Laudrup.

Ajax Amsterdam: 1-Edwin van der Sar; 2-John Veldman, 4-Frank de Boer, 20-Marcio Santos, 29-Mario Melchiot, 6-Ronald de Boer, 8-Richard Witschge, 7-Tajani Babangida, 11-Marc Overmars, 19-Arnold Scholten, 9-Patrick Kluivert.
